Official field/statistics documents of all three datasets reviewed
TON-IoT label semantics re-verified against official description

binary_label.role: the only mandatory cross-dataset unified label

ton_iot.evidence_source: Network Features-Description.pdf row 45: 'Tag normal and attack records, where 0 indicates normal and 1 indicates attacks'

ciciot2023.rule: Benign_Final -> benign; the other 33 categories -> attack

n_baiot.rule: benign_traffic.csv -> benign; gafgyt_attacks_extracted/ and mirai_attacks_extracted/ contents -> attack

canonical_family.role: conservative standardized family for within-dataset multiclass and genuinely-shared cross-dataset comparison

absent_families.rule: statement of coverage, never a negative class; families are never forced into an 'other' bucket for alignment

fixed_decisions.rule: Gafgyt tcp/udp are NOT re-labelled as ddos; Gafgyt scan is NOT merged into recon; malware family and behavior type are different axes. A separate behavior_tag may be added later if evidence supports it but never replaces canonical_family.
fixed_decisions.evidence_source: Meidan et al. 2018 (references/dataset_docs/n_baiot/meidan2018_arxiv_v1_2026-09-04.pdf, p.4): 'BASHLITE (also known as Gafgyt, Q-Bot, Torlus, Lizard-Stresser, and Lizkebab)'

canonical_family.note: Final family assignments are NOT frozen until the TON-IoT type inventory is complete and official documents are reviewed.

ciciot2023_type_mapping.description: v2 (revised after user verification of v1, per DECISIONS.md #17), FROZEN as CICIOT2023-TYPE-MAPPING-20260904-V1-FROZEN (per DECISIONS.md #18): Mapping of the 34 CICIoT2023 category directory names (33 attack categories plus Benign_Final) to canonical_family. All 34 entries are exact; 0 derived. Evidence basis: official README.pdf (SHA-256 0f48daba395be03985f612ce706d33f1a25e4008cb94c3ad7b6f6332fbdbee92) page-2 "Attacks Executed" classification table (7 category panels visually extracted, archived under references/dataset_docs/ciciot2023/readme_p2_panels/ with SHA-256 in registry.json) plus frozen inventory ciciot2023_20260903T142539Z.json (label_source: Directory and filename), plus the official UNB page snapshot unb_iotdataset_page_2026-09-04.html (SHA-256 99ae08c233d26aaa1c6cc5baa9eb6860587077cc2bc1097c63457bface422852). v1 -> v2 changes per user verification: (a) DictionaryBruteForce -> brute_force (exact; formerly password/derived, REJECTED) with candidate_families 13 -> 14; (b) explicitly recorded: TON-IoT password is NOT equated with CICIoT2023 brute_force - insufficient evidence for a cross-dataset comparison; the comparison-candidate phrase in the frozen TON-IoT password rationale is superseded by DECISIONS.md #17 and not established; (c) accepted as proposed in v1: spoofing family, MITM-ArpSpoofing -> spoofing (exact), Backdoor_Malware -> web_attack (exact). Official-source inconsistency disclosure: the UNB page states 33 attacks but its own category detail lists enumerate only 32 (the DDoS list omits DDoS-ICMP_Fragmentation); the frozen dataset directories and README.pdf both contain DDoS-ICMP_Fragmentation, so the formal enumeration baseline is the frozen inventory directories plus README.pdf, not the UNB page detail lists. Naming reconciliation between README attack names and the 34 directory names: normalization covers case, spacing, underscores and hyphens; the README lists the single attack name 'Dictionary Brute Force' (one attack name rendered across three lines by the PDF page layout), which is carried by the single DictionaryBruteForce directory; VulnerabilityScan lacks the Recon- prefix but its official category is Recon; Backdoor_Malware's directory name conflicts with its official Web-based category. All 34 entries carry decision_status=frozen as CICIOT2023-TYPE-MAPPING-20260904-V1-FROZEN (frozen from evidence V2R2 ZIP SHA-256 f8529ea2c721057ce205b862ff37bb3a4cbcb1c8d5524d30cc0b28f93f3d447b, source commit 93e8350, per DECISIONS.md #18; no mapping, semantic_disposition, evidence, or rationale was changed by the freeze).

n_baiot_type_mapping.description: Mapping of the N-BaIoT source families and subtypes to canonical_family. All 11 entries carry decision_status=proposed (proposed as N-BAIOT-TYPE-MAPPING-20260904-V1-PROPOSED; nothing is frozen in this proposal; the gafgyt->bashlite family decision is already frozen as a fixed_decision, and this proposal extends that frozen family decision to the 5 gafgyt subtypes). Evidence basis: Meidan et al. 2018 (references/dataset_docs/n_baiot/meidan2018_arxiv_v1_2026-09-04.pdf, SHA-256 1fa5bc4d4d2a12c2e93b18c4d876bd83ab7f456797934fcc71c92db754811964) pages 4-5 'Attacks executed' enumeration (5 BASHLITE attacks: Scan, Junk, UDP, TCP, COMBO; 5 Mirai attacks: Scan, Ack, Syn, UDP, UDPplain) plus frozen inventory n_baiot_20260903T224404Z.json (label_source: Directory and filename). The N-BaIoT frozen CSVs carry no label column (115 aggregated statistics columns), so the file location is the sole label carrier.
